lane_name: Amplitude-Invariant Gradient-Phase Concordance (GPC) multi-field fault detection
hypothesis: Faults missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue juxtapose basement and basin fill, so the unit-gradient directions of RTP magnetics, isostatic gravity, depth-to-basement and detrended elevation agree across the same line (mean/min pairwise |cos|, double-angle consensus, cross-scale persistence, zero-crossing concordance) even where each field's gradient magnitude is weak; adding these 15 label-free phase features to the matched 59-feature base stack raises pooled HOLDOUT-DTI.
mechanism: src/kanler3/gpc.py: per-field Gaussian-smoothed unit gradients at 1 px and 3 px, pairwise absolute/signed direction cosines, double-angle consensus resultant and >=25-degree consensus count, Laplacian zero-crossing mean, local relative sharpness.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contacts, playa shorelines, volcanic flow edges and survey flight-line seams, which can align at most two fields and should fail the minimum-pairwise and >=3-field consensus terms.
evaluator: src/gems/holdout.py SegmentHoldout (vendored byte-for-byte from GEMSDOE24@fc2bc6f via GEMSDOE36 registry/template_pins.json), buffer_px=15 (1500 m), whole 8-connected segments withheld, visible faults masked pixel-exactly, pooled DTI alpha=0.2 beta=0.8 300 m triangular kernel

arms.EXP-2: B0 + 12 GPC concordance features (no consensus cos2/sin2, no signed RTP-gravity polarity)
arms.EXP-3: EXP-1 surface with emission restricted to >2 px from visible catalogue (fold-local)

gates.promotion: paired 95% CI vs B0 strictly positive AND pooled HOLDOUT-DTI above recorded same-evaluator group best

recorded_group_best.name: GEMSDOE24 DPRF1 (site-reported, same evaluator gems-segment-pooled-v1, 60988 withheld)

gates.format: whole-array finite [0,1], CRS/shape/transform = template, single-band float32, -zeros variant

banned_inputs: any prior submission/registry raster as feature or target
